purpose: Honest trial count for multiple-testing statistics (reality check, PBO, deflated Sharpe). Lists every benchmarked decision variant with a recorded, reproducible result. Variants tried but never recorded cannot be enumerated, so any trial count from this file is a lower bound.

decision_variants.period: 2026-01-02 to 2026-06-30, 25 US large caps, weekly reviews
decision_variants.config: Baseline feature set; next hourly open fills; no fees, slippage, or risk checks

decision_variants.period: 2026-01-02 to 2026-06-30, same dates, symbols, model and execution rules
decision_variants.config: Baseline feature set plus two additional market features

decision_variants.dataset: docs/backtest-2026-09-28 (Yahoo snapshot, 5 bps commission, 10 bps slippage)
decision_variants.period: 2026-09-28 warmup, weekly decisions to 2026-10-27, 25 US large caps
decision_variants.config: Single model call per decision; the original published flagship run

decision_variants.dataset: docs/backtest-2026-09-28 (same frozen flagship snapshot and rules)
decision_variants.verdict: Rejected: identical results at 5x cost on a near-deterministic provider (issue #7); the flag is not on master

decision_variants.dataset: docs/backtest-2026-09-28-alpaca (Alpaca IEX hourly snapshot, 5 bps commission, 10 bps slippage)
decision_variants.period: 2026-09-28 warmup, weekly decisions to 2026-10-27, same 25-stock universe

decision_variants.config: Fresh nondeterministic re-run for the forecast pairing, flat-cost execution
decision_variants.reproduce: uv run --locked --extra forecast ft backtest --slippage-model flat --data-dir docs/backtest-2026-09-28-alpaca --start 2026-09-28 --end 2026-10-27 --symbols $(cat docs/backtest-2026-09-28-alpaca/symbols.txt) --model jev-1.14.0 --output baseline-new.json (incurs provider charges)

decision_variants.dataset: docs/backtest-2026-09-28-alpaca (same frozen Alpaca snapshot as tsfm-baseline)
decision_variants.model: jev-1.14.0 with Chronos-Bolt Tiny next-bar quantiles supplied (revision a0e552de...)
decision_variants.config: Optional local forecast feature enabled; forecast is nondeterministic and unvalidated
decision_variants.verdict: Unvalidated research feature (issue #13): 2.10% versus the paired 2.30% baseline, 16 of 100 actions differ, not equal-cost; a single run per condition cannot separate forecast effects from run-to-run noise

replay_overlays.note: These replay the recorded alpaca-baseline decisions under different simulated sizing or execution; they add no decision trials and are excluded from the trial count.
replay_overlays.reproduce: uv run --locked python docs/replay_sizing.py [--drawdown .02]; uv run --locked python docs/replay_impact_costs.py

sharpe_deflation_family.note: IDs are the report comparison_mode values. Only these two recorded variants share one frozen snapshot with complete aligned excess returns, so they are the only family that can be jointly deflated, reality-checked, or CSCV-scored. N=2 is a lower bound on the trials actually run.
